findings.current: Im Kkeokjeong and Miss Song, who were standing nearby, whispered to each other.
findings.defect: The source addresses her as 송이 씨, using the established short name Song-i, but the translation reduces it to the surname-only “Miss Song.” This also erases the deliberate distinction from 송 양, correctly rendered as “Miss Song” in the following dialogue.
findings.rationale: The exact glossary binds 송이 to “Song-i”; only 송 양 in the next line is the surname-based address “Miss Song.”
findings.replacement: Im Kkeokjeong and Miss Song-i, who were standing nearby, whispered to each other.

findings.current: His gaze passed over them—briefly over Im Kkeokjeong, then lingering a little longer on Miss Song.
findings.defect: 송이 씨 is again rendered with the surname-only “Miss Song” instead of the binding short name Song-i.
findings.rationale: The source uses 송이 씨, and the exact glossary requires “Song-i.”
findings.replacement: His gaze passed over them—briefly over Im Kkeokjeong, then lingering a little longer on Miss Song-i.

findings.current: It was Miss Song’s voice from outside the changing room. As soon as Team Leader Choi answered, the door eased open.
findings.defect: The source identifies the voice with 송이 씨, but the translation substitutes the surname-only form.
findings.rationale: The exact glossary binds 송이 to “Song-i.”
findings.replacement: It was Miss Song-i’s voice from outside the changing room. As soon as Team Leader Choi answered, the door eased open.

findings.current: And yet… why was he bothering me so much? Was it because that punk seemed interested in Miss Song?
findings.defect: 송이 씨 is once more reduced to the surname-only “Miss Song,” losing the established short-name form.
findings.rationale: The exact glossary requires “Song-i” for 송이.
findings.replacement: And yet… why was he bothering me so much? Was it because that punk seemed interested in Miss Song-i?

findings.current: Team Leader Choi had completely lost the will to fight by then and changed into his equipment without another word. Meanwhile, I checked each piece of equipment I was wearing.
findings.defect: The translation invents his silence and omits 힘없이, which specifies that he changes equipment listlessly or without energy.
findings.rationale: 힘없이 describes the physical manner of his changing clothes; the source does not state that he does so without speaking.
findings.replacement: Team Leader Choi had completely lost the will to fight by then and listlessly changed into his equipment. Meanwhile, I checked each piece of equipment I was wearing.

findings.current: It wasn’t just love making me see her through rose-colored glasses. That was simply the truth.
findings.defect: The source explicitly denies that romantic bias is responsible, whereas “wasn’t just love” concedes that love is at least partly affecting his perception.
findings.rationale: 콩깍지가 아니라 rejects the rose-colored-glasses explanation outright; it does not qualify it as merely one contributing cause.
findings.replacement: I wasn’t blinded by infatuation. She really was that beautiful.

summary: The chapter is largely faithful, but it repeatedly replaces the binding given-name form “Song-i” with the surname-only “Song,” omits one physical manner detail, and weakens an explicit denial of romantic bias.
